title: Index Funds Now Hold Most Stock Assets And Major Votes
hook: Your index fund also gives its manager corporate voting power.
closing: Index funds now hold most assets, while their managers cast major corporate votes.
question: Who votes the shares in your fund?

segments.say: Index funds now hold 52 percent of US stock assets, moving from the fringe to the majority.
BlackRock, Vanguard, and State Street together own 22 percent of a typical large company.
Vanguard alone casts 9 percent of votes at big-company shareholder meetings.
